tasks.cc:465-523 correct. Tasks::Decode/Prefill are called only from the execution managers (pipeline.cc has no users): ThreadedExecutionManager runs them on its one-thread execution_thread_pool; SerialExecutionManager (single_threaded_execution) runs them in RunNextTask on the caller's thread (WaitUntilDone). corrected_text: Tasks calls the executor synchronously on the thread that runs the task: Decode(decode_params) for internal sampling and DecodeLogits(inputs) for external sampling. Under ThreadedExecutionManager (the default) that is the single execution thread; with single_threaded_execution, SerialExecutionManager runs tasks on the thread that waits for them.
